Name: Lavender Meadows
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[font=Times New Roman]adds a new farm to your game~


[b][u][size=4]features[/size][/u][/b]

⋆ renewable hardwood stumps
⋆ forest spa for energy regen
⋆ minecart shortcuts (optional)
⋆ bigger farm cave (optional)


[b][u][size=4]requirements[/size][/u][/b]

⋆ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]daisyniko's tilesheets[/url]


[b][u][size=4]recommended [/size][/u][/b]

⋆ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]destroyable bushes[/url]
⋆ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8203]greenhouse entry be gone[/url]


[b][u][size=4]config options[/size][/u][/b]

⋆ UseBigFarmCave: true or false (disable to use vanilla cave or another cave mod)
⋆ EnableDecorations: true or false (enable/disable static lamps and big trees)
⋆ EnableDebris: true or false (enable/disable the mess on spring 1 year 1)
⋆ Minecart Shortcut Names (you can rename each one to whatever you like; it can have spaces, but make sure the name is enclosed in quotes "")


[b][u][size=4]installation[/size][/u][/b]

1. download requirements
2. extract mod folder to Stardew Valley/Mods
3. run the game with SMAPI to generate config.json file in the mod folder
4. edit the config file if you like; save the file; restart the game to play
